24 Magic Squares on a 4D Hypercube
Orders 3×3 to 12×12

Created by Inder J. Taneja

A four-dimensional hypercube (tesseract) has 16 vertices, 32 edges, 24 square faces and 8 cubic cells. Each of its 24 faces carries an n×n magic square, and together the 24 squares use every number from 1 to 24n² exactly once. Watch the hypercube turn through the fourth dimension while 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 and finally all 24 faces light up.
